questions.explanation:
and are colourless as they contain no unpaired electron. Whereas the transition metal ions and are coloured as they contain unpaired electrons.

The unpaired electron from lower energy orbital gets excited to a higher energy orbital on absorbing light of frequency which lies in visible region. The colour complementary to light absorbed is observed.
